Big first step

From a free PDF to a 4-week commitment

Someone who downloads your guide today can wait for the next round of The Initiation or apply for 1:1. There's no low-cost, live way to experience you in between, so many simply stay quiet on your list.

Timing

Your best entry point opens and closes

The Initiation runs 11 November to 9 December. Anyone who finds you after enrolment closes has nothing to join until the next round, and their interest cools while they wait.

Reach

New people arrive when the algorithm shows a post

574 posts have built 25.9k followers. That reach is real, but it rises and falls with how often you show up, and every round of The Initiation and every 1:1 spot depends on it.

The people who aren't ready for 1:1 today leave without a paid next step built for them, and you can't see who is ready.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass that becomes the front door to everything you offer

Your free guide stays as it is. The class becomes the first paid step: $17 for a live hour with you. A small practice kit is offered on the thank-you page, and the replay page is where the right people apply for 1:1 or join the next round of The Initiation.

Every ad and reel points to one live class that runs all year. Each seat is a paying buyer on your list, whether they go further or not, and the seats help pay for the ads.

The 95%*

Not ready for 1:1 yet

They pay $17 for the class, some add the Soothe Practice Kit, and they stay close through your emails and Substack. Many will be the first to join the next round of The Initiation. You're paid to begin the relationship.

The qualified 5%

Ready to go deeper with you

They stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application shows you who they are and what they're moving through, and the pre-call emails prepare them for 1:1 work, virtual or in Delaware.

Who this class is for

For people stepping into a new chapter

  • You're changing careers, relationships, cities or the way you see yourself.
  • You've read the books and want something you can practise, not just understand.
  • You're curious how somatic work can support you through change.
  • You want to learn from Oliviah live before going deeper.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll explore in 60 minutes

Why change is felt in the body

How identity shifts show up as sensations, habits and reactions, and how to start noticing them with curiosity.

The basics of your nervous system

A simple, educational map of how the body responds to change, in plain language.

A 3-minute somatic pause

A gentle practice to come back to yourself during a busy or uncertain day. We'll do it together, live.

Listening to your inner wisdom

Ways to slow down and hear what your body is telling you before you make a big decision.

Your first step this week

One small practice to begin straight after class, so it stays with you beyond the hour.

Questions

Before you get your seat

Why is it $17 and not free?

Because people who invest a little show up and take part. The $17 keeps the room small enough for real Q&A.

What if I can't make it live?

Register anyway. The replay is available for 72 hours after the class.

Is this therapy or medical care?

No. It's an educational coaching class. It isn't therapy, medical care or a diagnosis, and it doesn't replace working with a licensed professional.

Do I need to turn my camera on?

No. You can follow the practice quietly, and share in the chat if you'd like to.

Educational content, not medical advice. Coaching, not therapy or medical advice.

Script 1 · "The body notices first"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Big life changes often show up in the body before the mind catches up."

Body

"A new job, a move, the end of a relationship, a new way of seeing yourself. We usually try to think our way through it. Somatic work invites the body into the process, with simple practices you can use any time."

CTA

"I'm teaching a few of them in a live 60-minute masterclass, Come Home to Your Body. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up."

Shot: Oliviah outdoors by the water in autumn light, talking to camera.

Script 2 · "Three minutes"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"What do you do in the moment before you react?"

Body

"Most of us skip straight to the reaction. There's a short somatic pause I share with the people I work with. It takes about three minutes, and it's a gentle way to come back to yourself in the middle of a busy day."

CTA

"I'll guide you through it live in my masterclass. Tap Sign up to get your seat."

Shot: Oliviah seated, slows down, breathes, talks to camera. On-screen text "3 minutes".

Script 3 · "Inner wisdom"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Most of us were taught to look outside ourselves for every answer."

Body

"Books, podcasts, advice from everyone around us. All useful. But somatic work is about learning to listen inward too, and that's a skill you can practise. It starts with slowing down and noticing."

CTA

"Join me for Come Home to Your Body, live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: talking to camera outdoors, cut to autumn trees and water b-roll (no other faces).

Every ad points to the masterclass, makes no health or outcome promises and carries "Educational content, not medical advice." in the caption.
